timestamp_claim: Local pre-run specification only. This is not an independent timestamp or externally sealed preregistration.
purpose: Establish an executable reference for typed, role-bound, scoped, versioned relational state and actual execution receipts before introducing learned interfaces.
treatment: Exact rational executable hypergraph kernel with immutable source records, named argument roles, scope snapshots, explicit revisions, bounded evaluation, dependency tracking, and deterministic replay receipts.
comparators: Independent exact reference evaluator with the same command semantics
Conventional cached dependency DAG with correct invalidation and the same permitted inputs

input_contract.form: Synthetic structured commands; correct parsing is supplied by the fixture generator
input_contract.numbers: Integers or strings accepted by the specified exact rational parser; floats and bools are refused
input_contract.scope: References resolve within one scope; fork snapshots definitions; later parent changes do not alter the fork
input_contract.revision: set and derive explicitly replace the current definition in that scope; retraction makes dependent queries unresolved until a valid definition is supplied
input_contract.provenance: A named source must already exist and source records cannot silently change

planned_evaluation.semantic_outcome_projection: Query/assert outcomes compare status, normalized rational value and unit, or normalized error code. Receipts and timing are evaluated separately.
planned_evaluation.literal_controls: Hand-computed results independently test arithmetic, units, noncommutative roles, snapshots, invalidation, and explicit conflicts
planned_evaluation.execution_replay: Replaying the actual receipt sequence must reproduce outputs and final state; altered or fabricated receipts must be rejected
planned_evaluation.invalid_inputs: Malformed values, roles, operators, references, sources, cycles, and resource boundaries must return declared errors or validation refusal without partial state mutation
planned_evaluation.budget: CPU-only bounded pilot in the current session environment; no model downloads, training, production traffic, or workstation benchmark claim

acceptance.semantic_correctness: Every declared literal semantic test passes; all generated comparable query/assert outcomes agree with the independent reference
acceptance.control_integrity: Required role, scope, revision, irrelevant-information, source, replay, tamper, and resource-boundary controls pass
acceptance.determinism: Repeated commands reproduce semantic state and receipts in the same deterministic implementation; timing is excluded
acceptance.performance: No superiority threshold is set for this engineering pilot; measure actual construction, update, query, and trace overhead descriptively
acceptance.failure_reporting: Record failing tests and repairs. Revisions to this specification must retain the original record and receive a dated amendment before the affected rerun. Do not relabel a post-result criterion as preregistered.

allowed_conclusions: The implemented structured command semantics passed or failed the recorded controls
Actual accepted/rejected computations are replayable under the tested implementation and input contract
Observed CPU time and memory are properties of this implementation on this session host
The selected baseline does or does not match the kernel's semantic outputs
excluded_conclusions: Tenfold model capability or general intelligence improvement
Training or evaluation of a neural language model
Natural-language understanding or reliable semantic extraction
Complete mechanistic interpretability of learned components
World causality or truth established by computational dependency traces
Cryptographic authenticity or independent timestamping from an unkeyed hash chain
Spectral, sheaf, tokenizer, or hypergraph superiority over equivalent ordinary data structures
Performance on the user's local GPU or production trainer
Modification of frozen T-38 or reopening the killed packing experiment
advancement: Only consider a learned-interface follow-up after semantic and trace integrity pass and a useful task-specific representation hypothesis survives comparison with competent conventional storage and tools. Equal correctness with greater overhead is valid negative evidence for an efficiency claim.
